alt: 雕刻師細修木鳥的羽毛與枝葉，桌邊落著木屑，兩位觀眾睜大眼睛靠近欣賞。
scene_prompt: A master woodcarver in a sunlit modern craft studio uses a small carving chisel with anatomically correct careful hands to finish an astonishingly delicate lifelike wooden bird perched on finely carved branching leaves, all visibly wood with grain and small shavings. Two observers lean in with wide-eyed wonder at the exquisite craftsmanship. Clear real skill and impressive finished object, no magic or spirits.
